Class SpringBeanAutowiringSupport

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.context.support.SpringBeanAutowiringSupport
public abstract class SpringBeanAutowiringSupport extends Object
Convenient base class for self-autowiring classes that gets constructed within a Spring-based web application. Resolves @Autowired annotations in the endpoint class against beans in the current Spring root web application context (as determined by the current thread's context ClassLoader, which needs to be the web application's ClassLoader). Can alternatively be used as a delegate instead of as a base class.

此类基础类的典型用法是 JAX-WS 端点类： 基于 Spring 的此类 JAX-WS 端点实现将遵循端点类的标准 JAX-WS 契约，但其设计“轻量”，因为它会将实际工作委托给一个或多个由 Spring 管理的服务 Bean——通常通过 `@Autowired` 获取。 此类端点实例的生命周期将由 JAX-WS 运行时管理，因此需要此基础类提供基于当前 Spring 上下文的 `@Autowired` 处理机制。

注意：如果存在显式访问 ServletContext 的方式，请优先采用该方式，而不是使用此类。WebApplicationContextUtils类允许基于 ServletContext 轻松访问 Spring 根 Web 应用程序上下文。
